name: Harvard University
note: Fall 2025 entry (CDS 2025-26): 2,003 admits of 47,893 applicants. SAT/ACT required again from Fall 2025 entry; CDS does not report an SAT composite range (sections: EBRW 720-770, Math 730-790), so satMid50 is null. Reported average HS GPA 4.22 is on a weighted scale, so gpaAvg is null. No English proficiency test minimum is published or required. Need-blind for all applicants including internationals; meets 100% of demonstrated need; internationals get the same aid as US students. Cost is 2025-26: tuition $59,320 + fees $5,476; living = housing $13,532 + food $8,598 + personal $2,500 + books $1,000 (excluding travel and health insurance).

name: Stanford University
note: Fall 2025 entry (CDS 2025-26): 2,302 admits of 60,646 applicants. GPA 3.94 is the CDS C12 average; the CDS does not say whether it is weighted. SAT/ACT required again for Fall 2026 applicants onward. No English proficiency test minimum published, so the English fields are null. Need-based aid for internationals, but admission is need-aware (not need-blind) for them; meets full need once admitted. Cost from CDS section G (form labels it 2026-27): tuition $67,731 + fees $843; living = food & housing $22,944 + books $855 + other $5,172.

name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
deadlines: EA Nov 1; RA early January (check mitadmissions.org)
note: Fall 2025 entry (CDS 2025-26): 1,334 admits of 29,281 applicants. MIT does not report GPA. English test needed only if English is not your home or school language or you have used it fewer than 5 years; recommended scores are IELTS 7.5, TOEFL 100 and DET 125. TOEFL tests taken after Jan 21 2026 use the new 1-6 scale (min 5.0). Need-blind for international applicants too, meets full need (411 nonresidents received avg $81,991). Costs are 2026-27 (the only year on the official page): tuition $66,720 + student life fee $420; living = housing $14,090 + food $8,104 + books $930 + personal $2,496.

name: Cornell University
note: Fall 2025 entry (CDS 2025-26): 6,077 admits of 72,523 applicants. The nonresident admit rate is much lower: 664 of 18,566 (about 3.6%). No average GPA reported. SAT/ACT required. English minimums are the 'most competitive' scores on the admissions site; TOEFL tests from Jan 2026 need 5.0 (5.5 recommended) on the new scale. Need-aware for internationals, meets full demonstrated need once admitted; you must apply for aid when applying or you can never get it. Costs from CDS section G (2026-27): tuition $73,946 + fees $1,024; living = food & housing $21,348 + books $1,234 + other $2,182.

name: University of Michigan (Ann Arbor)
note: Fall 2025 entry (CDS 2025-26): 17,915 admits of 109,112 applicants. CDS C8 lists SAT/ACT as 'Recommended' (not required) for Fall 2027. GPA 3.9 is the CDS C12 average; the scale is not stated. TOEFL 100 (section minimums apply) is from secondary sources; the official exams page returned 403. IELTS minimum is unverified, and sources disagree on whether Duolingo is accepted, so those are null. Need-based aid for internationals is very limited. Costs from CDS section G (2026-27, first-year international): tuition $66,602 + required fees $494 + international student fee $1,000; living = food & housing $17,220 + books $1,220 + other $2,458. Tuition varies by school/college and is higher in upper-division years.

name: University of California, Los Angeles
note: Fall 2025 entry: 13,659 admits of 145,085 applicants (9.4%). gpaAvg is the median unweighted GPA of admits (UC-calculated from grades 10-11, middle 50% 3.95-4.00); median weighted is 4.61. UC is test-blind, so SAT/ACT are not considered. English minimums are the UC system-wide standard (TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.5 / DET 115) and were not checked on a UCLA page this pass. No need-based aid for internationals. Costs are nonresident on-campus figures (page labels 2025-26, updated Jul 2026): university fees $16,430 + nonresident supplemental tuition $39,270; living = food & housing $19,867 + books $1,588 + personal $2,761 (health insurance $3,885 and transport $969 are extra).

name: University of Oxford
indiaReqNote: Oxford accepts only CBSE and CISCE (ISC) Class XII, not state boards or NIOS. Oxford's 2012/2014 announcement set 90% in each of five Class XII subjects. Recent secondary summaries describe ISC as 90% overall with 95%+ in four subjects (including relevant ones) and 85%+ in the fifth; CBSE is tiered by course. 'high' = 95% in relevant subjects. The official international-qualifications page blocked automated access (403), so check it.
tuitionNote: 2026-27 overseas course fees could not be retrieved (ox.ac.uk returned 403). Fees vary by course band, and Medicine is much higher. Oxford no longer charges a separate college fee; it is included in the course fee. Check ox.ac.uk/admissions/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/course-fees.
deadlines: UCAS Oct 15 (6pm UK); admissions tests in October/November; interviews in December
note: acceptanceRate 16.7% = 3,891 offers of 23,329 applications, as quoted from the Annual Admissions Statistical Report via search; the PDF itself was blocked (403). Treat as approximate. Most courses need a subject admissions test (e.g. TSA, MAT, PAT, LNAT, UCAT for Medicine), and shortlisted applicants are interviewed in December. CBSE/ISC are accepted on their own, so SAT/AP are not needed for Indian-board applicants; SAT is used only with a US-style diploma. English: IELTS 7.0 is the standard level (7.5 for the higher level) and TOEFL iBT 100 (110 higher), TOEFL only if taken before Jan 21 2026; these figures are from memory of Oxford's policy, not a page fetched this pass. Duolingo is not accepted. Living cost uses the official 2026-27 estimate of GBP 1,405-2,105 per month x 9 months, midpoint. Almost no need-based aid for internationals (limited scholarships such as Reach Oxford; check eligibility).

name: University of Cambridge
indiaReqNote: CBSE Class XII: minimum A1 in five relevant subjects (A1 = top eighth of candidates per subject, roughly 90%+), accepted only by some colleges (about 19) and for a limited list of mostly arts/humanities courses. CISCE/ISC and NIOS: 90%+ in five or more relevant subjects. For other courses and colleges you need extra qualifications, e.g. 5+ AP tests at score 5 plus A1s in Class XII, or A Levels/IB. No official 'high' percentage is published, so it is null.
tuitionNote: 2026-27 international university fee: GBP 29,052 (most arts/humanities) to 44,214 (sciences/engineering/CS); Medicine and Vet Med GBP 70,554. tuitionGBP is the midpoint of the non-medical range. There is a separate compulsory college fee of GBP 11,500-14,950 per year depending on college. International fees are fixed for the whole course.
deadlines: UCAS Oct 15 (6pm UK) + My Cambridge Application; admissions tests in Oct/Nov; interviews in December
note: 2025 cycle: 4,893 offers of 22,513 applications (21.7%). Much tougher for internationals: overseas-school applicants got 1,101 offers of 7,633 (14.4%), and India-domiciled applicants got 38 offers of 370 (about 10%). Most courses use an admissions test (e.g. ESAT, TMUA, LNAT, UCAT for Medicine, or college-set assessments), and nearly all shortlisted applicants are interviewed. SAT is not used; for most courses CBSE applicants need AP scores (5+ APs at 5). English: IELTS 7.5 (7.0 per element) or TOEFL iBT 110 (25 per component; only tests before Jan 21 2026). Duolingo is not accepted. Living cost is the official 2026-27 term-time estimate (GBP 15,660 if staying all year). Scholarships for internationals are limited and competitive (Cambridge Trust).
